omelet-cheese.title: Cheese omelet
steps: Grate the cheese. Beat the eggs with the salt using a fork.
Heat the oil over medium heat and pour in the eggs. Once the edges set, reduce the heat.
Sprinkle with the cheese, cover and cook until the omelet is set.

omelet-tomato.title: Tomato omelet
steps: Chop the tomatoes into small pieces. Beat the eggs with the salt.
Heat the oil and fry the tomatoes for 3–4 minutes to cook off some of their moisture.
Pour the eggs over the tomatoes, cover and cook over low heat until the omelet is fully set.

omelet-mushroom.title: Button mushroom omelet
steps: Thinly slice the mushrooms. Beat the eggs with the salt.
Heat the oil and fry the mushrooms until tender and their moisture has evaporated.
Pour in the eggs, reduce the heat, cover and cook until the omelet is fully set.

pasta-garlic.title: Garlic pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water according to the package instructions. Save some of the cooking water.
Thinly slice the garlic and gently heat it in the oil over low heat until fragrant.
Toss the pasta with the garlic oil and a spoonful of the reserved water.

pasta-tomato.title: Tomato and garlic pasta
steps: Start cooking the pasta in salted water according to the package instructions.
Chop the tomatoes and garlic. Gently heat the garlic in the oil, then add the tomatoes and simmer for 7–8 minutes.
Drain the pasta and add it to the tomatoes. Toss and heat through.

pasta-cheese.title: Cheese pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water according to the package instructions. Grate the cheese.
Transfer the pasta to a skillet and add the oil and a couple of spoonfuls of cooking water.
Take the skillet off the heat, stir in the cheese and serve immediately.

toast-tomato.title: Crisp tomato toast
steps: Toast the bread on both sides in a dry skillet.
Rub the bread with the garlic. Chop the tomatoes and toss them with the salt and oil.
Spoon the tomatoes onto the toast just before serving.

toast-cheese.title: Hot cheese toast
steps: Brown the bread on one side in a dry skillet.
Flip the bread, top it with thin slices of cheese and cover the skillet.
Cook over low heat until the cheese melts and the bread is crisp.

salad.title: Cucumber and tomato salad
steps: Wash the vegetables and cut them into large pieces.
Dress with the oil, add the salt and toss just before serving.

buckwheat.title: Buckwheat with button mushrooms and onion
steps: Rinse the buckwheat and cook it in salted water according to the package instructions.
Chop the onion and mushrooms. Fry the onion in the oil first, then add the mushrooms and cook through.
Mix the cooked buckwheat with the mushrooms and onion.

beans.title: Warm beans with tomatoes
steps: Drain the beans. Chop the tomatoes and garlic.
Gently heat the garlic in the oil, add the tomatoes and simmer for 5–6 minutes.
Add the beans and salt and heat everything together for another 3–4 minutes.
